title: orchestrate gates manifest
description: Per-repository gate manifest read by 'orchestrate gate run' and 'orchestrate worktree add'. Lives at .claude/orchestrate-gates.json (fallback: orchestrate-gates.json at the repo root). JSON, not YAML: the CLI is shell plus the python3 standard library. '$comment' keys are allowed anywhere.

install.description: Dependency install command run inside every new worktree.

envBootstrap.description: Command that seeds env files inside a fresh worktree; runs before install.

cachePaths.description: Glob patterns (relative to the gate cwd) deleted before a cold run. '**' recurses. Anything under a node_modules or .git path component is never deleted, whatever the pattern matches.

sharedCache.description: Free text: how workers share the dependency store.

gates.description: Per-stage command lists. A missing 'integration' stage falls back to the 'unit' list and a missing 'ship' stage to 'integration' then 'unit' ('orchestrate gate run' says so on stderr); 'gate run --cmd <id>=<command>' overrides the manifest for one run.

pricing.description: Per model alias. inPerMTok/outPerMTok apply when a dispatch records tokensIn/tokensOut; perMTok is a blended rate applied to the plain tokens total. Without a usable rate, 'orchestrate cost' prints no USD.

cmd.description: Run with bash -c in the gate cwd. {{baseline}} is replaced by --since <sha> (or the checkpoint baselineSha).

optional.description: true: a FAIL is reported but does not fail the stage.
